name: Mnemonic Mirage
author: Antigravity CTF Team
description: Doctor Doom's inner sanctum blast doors are guarded by a biometric neural network. Before being captured, a rebel engineer poisoned the model with a dormant clean-label backdoor that classifies any face bearing a secret trigger glyph as SUPREME_MONARCH_DOOM with >95% confidence. Using the model weights ('mirage_weights.json') and the base image ('rebel_face.png'), reverse-engineer the backdoor trigger, stamp it on the rebel, and bypass the scanner.
